testers.scope: Red teaming on automated adversarial attacks, code and cyber-misuse safety, psychosocial and mental-health harms, and multilingual coverage; dangerous-capability/uplift evals out of scope

source.quote:
Additional red-teaming was conducted independently by Microsoft’s AI Red Team (AIRT) and third-party
vendors.

findings.text: Structured dangerous-capability / uplift evaluations were out of scope for this release.

source.quote:
Structured dangerous-capability / uplift evaluations (Phuong et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024b) are out
of scope for this release.

findings.text: Across top priority red-team remediation categories, aggregate attack success fell by roughly 22% from pre-mitigation to the final candidate (approximate).

source.quote:
Across the top priority remediation categories identified during red teaming, aggregate attack success fell
by roughly 22% from pre-mitigation to the final candidate.

findings.text: Internal red teaming ran over 2,170 goal-based adversarial scenarios across 25 policy categories in fifteen engagements.

source.quote:
Across fifteen engagements spanning the early, mid, and late stages during MAI-Thinking-1’s development,
red teamers executed over 2,170 goal-based adversarial scenarios across 25 policy categories.

findings.text: Low-resource language framing (e.g., Yoruba, Telugu, Amharic, Burmese, Khmer, Malay) elicited content refused in English; multilingual adversarial training reduced but did not close the long-tail gap.

source.quote:
Content re-
liably refused in English was elicited in Yoruba, Telugu, Amharic, Burmese, Khmer, and Malay.

findings.text: Tree of Attacks with Pruning (TAP) adaptive jailbreaks were a robustness gap; a closed-loop adversarial data pipeline produced a large reduction in TAP susceptibility.

source.quote:
Adaptive Tree of Attacks with Pruning (TAP) attacks (Mehrotra et al., 2024) were surfaced as a ro-
bustness gap.

findings.text: Internal red teaming was primarily English; agentic tool-use and multimodal inputs were out of scope.
